name: kuikly-devtools
description: Chrome-DevTools-style inspector for Kuikly (KMP) pages: live view tree, props, component state, logs and network.

scripts.build:ui: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:instrumentor && npm run build:ui
scripts.test: node test/protocol-contract.js && node test/hit-test.js && node test/blobs.js && node test/curl.js && node test/smoke.js && node test/history.js && node test/cli-servers.js && node test/inspect.js
